verdict: Ascended Heroes has held its value better since release: AH26 78.19 (100 = Feb 2026) vs DR25 57.81 (100 = May 2025) at the Oct 5 mark (−21.8% in ~8 months vs −42.2% in ~17). Same-age table (new): AH ahead at every month 1–8, but the lead narrowed from +51.73 pts (month 3) to +15.12 (month 8: AH 78.19 Oct 5 live vs DR 63.07 Jan 2026 recon). Since Aug 24 the order flips: DR −12.8% vs AH −14.6%; latest week AH −3.5% (5th straight fall) vs DR −0.6%. Top three sold-comp medians $2,110.00 vs $725.65. Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex: DR #231 $399.90 raw (41 sales, Sep 10–Oct 10), PSA 10 $939.00 (30 sales, Sep 4–Oct 4); AH #281 $244.50 raw (46), PSA 10 $570.00 (28). DR is the cheaper sealed entry: ETB $115.00 (22 live) vs $147.99 (14), bundle $50.99 (22) vs $70.99 (32); DR factory box $499.50 (3 live), no AH factory box listing (Oct 11).
